highlights: This release is driven by feedback from Scott and Greg. Thank you both! Send yours to sqlstudio_feedback@mateuszdabrowski.pl.
You can now use Save to DE to keep a run's results in a new Data Extension, with the field types, retention and send relationship you choose.
Shared snippets: save a piece of SQL once, and everyone who uses SQL Studio in the Business Unit can insert it.
Autocomplete keeps what you type, so SELECT ID stays ID. And a new Join to the query icon, on each table in the sidebar, writes that table's whole join into your query.
Data Extensions load in the sidebar up to four times faster, even if you have thousands of them. If you still see a timeout there, it's a call for an instance clean-up ;)
